{"name": "run_python", "arguments": {"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-read data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue and remove QA orders
df['revenue_float'] = pd.to_numeric(df['revenue'], errors='coerce')
qa_mask = (df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99)
df.loc[qa_mask, 'revenue_float'] = None
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['revenue_float'])

# Final filter: completed and converted = 1
valid_converted = (df_clean['converted'] == 1) & (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')
df_final = df_clean[valid_converted].copy()

# Compute average revenue per converted order by channel, within each customer_segment
results = []
for segment in df_final['customer_segment'].unique():
    subset = df_final[df_final['customer_segment'] == segment]
    email_avg = subset[subset['channel'] == 'email']['revenue_float'].mean()
    paid_search_avg = subset[subset['channel'] == 'paid_search']['revenue_float'].mean()
    diff = email_avg - paid_search_avg
    results.append({
        'segment': segment,
        'email_avg': round(email_avg, 2),
        'paid_search_avg': round(paid_search_avg, 2),
        'difference': round(diff, 2)
    })

# Convert to DataFrame
results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)
print(results_df)

# Check if email outperforms paid_search in every segment
all_positive = (results_df['difference'] > 0).all()
print(f'Email outperforms paid_search in every segment: {all_positive}')}}
